mapper.select: SELECT c.`id`, c.`objectType`, c.`controlTime`, c.`openGate`, c.`objectName`, c.`timeControlId`, c.`deviceObject`, c.`brightness`, d.`result` FROM ( SELECT a.`id` `id`, a.`object_type` `objectType`, a.`device_object` `deviceObject`, a.`control_time` `controlTime`, a.`open_gate` `openGate`, a.`brightness` `brightness`, a.`device_name` `objectName`, a.`time_control_id` `timeControlId`, b.`plan_start_time`, CONCAT( a.`device_object`, a.`time_control_id`,a.`control_time` ) AS `controlKey` FROM `time_control_details` a LEFT JOIN `time_control_info` b ON a.`time_control_id` = b.`id` WHERE b.`enabled` = TRUE and b.`time_cycle` like concat('%',#{timeCycle},'%') AND ( (b.`plan_end_time` >= #{endTime} and b.`plan_start_time` < #{endTime}) OR b.`plan_start_time` IS NULL ) ) c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT `result`, CONCAT( `device_object`, `time_control_id`,max(`history_time`) ) `logKey` FROM `time_control_log` where `control_time` BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY `device_object`,`time_control_id`,result ) d ON c.`controlKey` = d.`logKey` order by c.`controlTime` ASC
